_about: Public-domain Leonard Twells (d. 1742), rector of St Matthew's, Friday Street, and Lady Moyer lecturer, for the Word Hoard: his three Vindications of the Gospel of St. Matthew, and Twenty-four Sermons preached at St Mary le Bow. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 99 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

twells-vindication-matthew: A vindication of the Gospel of St. Matthew, against a late tract entitled, A dissertation or inquiry concerning the canonical authority of the Gospel according to Matthew. By Leonard Twells, ...  1732 (catalogued 1732)
twells-supplement-vindication: A supplement to the Vindication of the Gospel of St. Matthew, against a late tract, entitled, A dissertation or inquiry concerning the canonical authority of the Gospel according to Matthew. ... By Leonard Twells, ...  1733 (catalogued 1733)
twells-second-vindication: A second vindication of the Gospel of St. Matthew: in answer to the Second defence of the dissertation or inquiry concerning St. Matthew's Gospel. ... By Leonard Twells, ...  1735 (catalogued 1735)
twells-twenty-four-sermons: Twenty-four sermons preach'd at the Parish Church of St. Mary le Bow, London, in the years 1739, 1740, 1741, at the lecture founded by the Honourable Robert Boyle, Esq : and eight sermons preach'd at the Cathedral Church of St. Paul, in the years 1738 and 1739, at the lecture founded by the Honoured Lady Moyer, vol. 1 (London : [s.n.], 1743, 1743)
